title: pgstat - Locks & Activity Overview
description: Fleet-wide open, active, idle, idle-in-transaction sessions, long running queries, waiting locks, and progress operations.

list.query: select distinct coalesce(service_group, '(none)') from control.instance_inventory where is_active order by 1
list.name: service_group
list.label: Service Group

list.query: select display_name as __text, instance_pk::text as __value from control.instance_inventory where is_active and (coalesce(service_group, '(none)') in (${service_group:sqlstring})) order by display_name
list.name: instance
list.label: Instance

list.query: select distinct datname as __text, datname as __value from dim.database_ref where not is_template and (instance_pk::text in (${instance:sqlstring})) order by datname
list.name: database
list.label: Database

targets.rawSql: with latest as (select instance_pk, max(snapshot_ts) as ts from fact.pg_activity_snapshot where snapshot_ts > now() - interval '10 minutes' group by instance_pk) select count(*) as "value" from fact.pg_activity_snapshot a join latest l on l.instance_pk = a.instance_pk and l.ts = a.snapshot_ts join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = a.instance_pk where a.state is not null and (i.instance_pk::text in (${instance:sqlstring})) and (coalesce(i.service_group, '(none)') in (${service_group:sqlstring}))

panels.title: Instance Bazlı Aktivite Özet — tıkla, detaya git
panels.description: Her instance için anlık aktivite/idle/lock/vacuum sayıları. Bir satıra tıklayınca Instance Detail açılır.

targets.rawSql: with latest_activity as (select instance_pk, max(snapshot_ts) as ts from fact.pg_activity_snapshot where snapshot_ts > now() - interval '10 minutes' group by instance_pk), activity as (select a.instance_pk, count(*) filter (where a.state is not null) as open_cnt, count(*) filter (where a.state='active') as active_cnt, count(*) filter (where a.state='idle') as idle_cnt, count(*) filter (where a.state='idle in transaction') as idle_tx_cnt, count(*) filter (where a.state='active' and a.wait_event_type is not null) as waiting_cnt from fact.pg_activity_snapshot a join latest_activity l on l.instance_pk = a.instance_pk and l.ts = a.snapshot_ts group by a.instance_pk), latest_locks as (select instance_pk, max(snapshot_ts) as ts from fact.pg_lock_snapshot where snapshot_ts > now() - interval '10 minutes' group by instance_pk), locks as (select l.instance_pk, count(*) filter (where l.granted = false) as waiting_locks from fact.pg_lock_snapshot l join latest_locks x on x.instance_pk = l.instance_pk and x.ts = l.snapshot_ts group by l.instance_pk), latest_prog as (select instance_pk, max(snapshot_ts) as ts from fact.pg_progress_snapshot where snapshot_ts > now() - interval '10 minutes' group by instance_pk), prog as (select p.instance_pk, count(*) as prog_cnt from fact.pg_progress_snapshot p join latest_prog x on x.instance_pk = p.instance_pk and x.ts = p.snapshot_ts group by p.instance_pk) select i.instance_pk, i.display_name as instance, coalesce(i.service_group, '-') as group_name, coalesce(a.open_cnt, 0) as open, coalesce(a.active_cnt, 0) as aktif, coalesce(a.idle_cnt, 0) as idle, coalesce(a.idle_tx_cnt, 0) as idle_tx, coalesce(a.waiting_cnt, 0) as wait_event, coalesce(l.waiting_locks, 0) as bekleyen_lock, coalesce(p.prog_cnt, 0) as vacuum_progress from control.instance_inventory i left join activity a on a.instance_pk = i.instance_pk left join locks l on l.instance_pk = i.instance_pk left join prog p on p.instance_pk = i.instance_pk where i.is_active and (i.instance_pk::text in (${instance:sqlstring})) and (coalesce(i.service_group, '(none)') in (${service_group:sqlstring})) order by idle_tx desc nulls last, bekleyen_lock desc nulls last, aktif desc

with latest as (select instance_pk, max(snapshot_ts) as ts from fact.pg_activity_snapshot where snapshot_ts > now() - interval '10 minutes' group by instance_pk) select i.instance_pk, i.display_name as instance, a.snapshot_ts, a.pid, a.datname, a.usename as "user", a.state, a.wait_event_type, extract(epoch from (a.snapshot_ts - a.query_start))::int as "sure_sn", left(a.query, 200) as query from fact.pg_activity_snapshot a join latest l on l.instance_pk = a.instance_pk and l.ts = a.snapshot_ts join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = a.instance_pk where a.state = 'active' and a.query_start is not null and (a.snapshot_ts - a.query_start) > interval '1 minute' and (i.instance_pk::text in (${instance:sqlstring})) and (coalesce(i.service_group, '(none)') in (${service_group:sqlstring})) and (a.datname in (${database:sqlstring})) order by a.query_start asc limit 100

with latest as (select instance_pk, max(snapshot_ts) as ts from fact.pg_lock_snapshot where snapshot_ts > now() - interval '5 minutes' group by instance_pk) select i.instance_pk, i.display_name as instance, l.snapshot_ts, l.pid as bekleyen_pid, l.locktype, l.mode, array_to_string(l.blocked_by_pids, ',') as blocked_by, coalesce(extract(epoch from (l.snapshot_ts - l.waitstart))::int, 0) as bekleme_sn from fact.pg_lock_snapshot l join latest la on la.instance_pk = l.instance_pk and la.ts = l.snapshot_ts join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = l.instance_pk where l.granted = false and (i.instance_pk::text in (${instance:sqlstring})) and (coalesce(i.service_group, '(none)') in (${service_group:sqlstring})) order by l.waitstart asc limit 50
